O cartão \"LGPD em Risco\" conta os pedi: The "LGPD at Risk" card counts customers' requests about their own data (a copy or its deletion) that are still open and are due within the next 5 days or already overdue. It turns red when the count rises above zero. The "AI Budgets" card counts companies whose AI spending has reached 80% or more of their chosen cap. Notice that it refers to accumulated spending: this number does not reset at the start of a new month and may include spending from previous months. The "WAHA Alerts" card is meant to count WhatsApp numbers with connection problems. Currently it always stays at zero. To find out whether a company's number has disconnected, open its health page and check the "WAHA" card, which shows how many numbers are connected.
Antes de aprovar, use \"Pré-visualizar d: Before approving, use "Preview data" to check that this is the right person: the approval window does not show their name. Then click "Approve anonymization". In the "Approve contact anonymization" window, enter a reason of at least 10 characters in the "Justification" field and click "Confirm approval". This cannot be undone. The system replaces the customer's name with "Anonymized Customer" followed by a code and deletes their phone number, email, and the contents of their conversations, messages, and files. Dates are retained so your figures remain accurate. The request changes to "Processing" and, once finished, to "Completed".

Cada \"Salvar\" que dá certo vira uma li: Each successful "Save" adds a line to the server log, the "Audit" screen in the Admin menu. The line appears as "platform.internal_destinations_updated" and shows when the change was made. The "View" button at the end of the line opens the details. Under "Metadata", "de" is the previous list and "para" is the new one. A true "vinha_do_env" means that until then, the configuration file's settings applied. Os códigos de recuperação são a sua saíd: Recovery codes are your way back in if you lose your phone. On the screen asking for the code, click "I lost access to my authenticator" and enter one of them: the system disables verification for your account, and you sign in with just your password and register your new phone. Each code works only once. While two-step verification is off, the "Regenerate recovery codes" button is gray. With verification on, the button generates new codes and the old ones become invalid immediately. The message "Enable MFA before generating codes." means exactly that: enable verification first.
Clique em \"Rodízio automático entre os: Click "Automatic rotation among support staff". Each new customer goes to the person who has gone longest without receiving one, considering only available staff who are within working hours and have spare capacity. Selecting it reveals two fields. "Attempts before giving up" specifies how many times the system retries when no one is available. "Wait between attempts (seconds)" specifies the interval between attempts. When attempts run out, the conversation stays in the queue, a notice appears in "Alerts", and the system keeps trying at a slower pace, every 15 minutes.
Com o código certo, a janela mostra 10 c: With the correct code, the window displays 10 recovery codes. They will not appear again: use "Copy all" or "Download .txt", keep them somewhere safe, check "I saved my codes in a safe place.", and click "Finish". The page reloads. The image shows this screen before activation. Once you finish, the "Disabled" badge changes to "Enabled" and the gray "Regenerate recovery codes" button starts working. The "Enable" button becomes "Turn off", unless your company requires verification for you. From then on, every sign-in asks for the app's code.
O quadro \"Trilha de auditoria\" lista o: The "Audit trail" box lists what happened to the request, from oldest to newest, with dates and times: its arrival ("lgpd.data_request_received"), company approval ("lgpd.manually_approved"), and file generation ("lgpd.export_generated"). When a record stores who performed the action, "by" appears with the beginning of that person's code. Each time someone opens this record, that is also logged ("platform_admin.lgpd_request_viewed") and appears here on a subsequent visit (if you reopen it immediately, reload the page to see it).
Quando um paciente que veio de um anúnci: When a patient who came from an ad makes a purchase and the deal is marked as won, the sale amount is sent back to the ad platform. That feedback teaches the ad to find more people similar to those who bought. The screen has four tabs: "Configuration" (the Meta connection, a Google Ads card, sales that did not arrive, and tracking people who come through the website), "Sending history" (each sending attempt), "Diagnostics" (the health of the Google Ads connection), and "Trackable links" (links that identify where the customer came from).
No designer, cada caixa é um passo da re: In the designer, each box is a step in the rule. Ao publicar, o sistema confere o fluxo i: When publishing, the system checks the entire flow. If something is missing, the component with the problem gets a red border and the flow is not published. If successful, the badge changes to "Active". In a silence flow, yellow notices may appear about limits still missing from the trigger. Read and adjust them. Em \"Endereço do servidor MCP\" vai o en: Enter the address your system provider gave you under "MCP server address". Under "Access key", enter the access password; it appears as dots while you type. Directly below are "Save", which stores both, and "Test connection", which asks the external system what it offers. Farther down, separately, is "Remove", which deletes the configuration. The gray text in the address field (https://erp.example.com/mcp) is only a format example: the field is empty.
\"Manual (atendente puxa da fila)\": nin: "Manual (staff take from the queue)": no one receives conversations automatically; the conversation waits in the Queue until someone takes over. "Rotation (automatic distribution)": the system assigns a conversation to each staff member in turn. "Lowest workload (fewest conversations in hand)": it goes to the person with the fewest open conversations. In both automatic modes, only staff on duty with spare capacity and without "Read-only" access receive them; if the number has a list of assigned staff, only those on the list qualify.
Tarefas é a lista do que a equipe combin: Tasks is the list of things the team has agreed to do, such as "call back on Tuesday". The screen groups tasks by their due date. "Overdue" comes first, in red, because it needs action now: these are tasks due on a day that has already passed. Then come "Today", "This week" (the next 7 days), "Later", and finally "No due date". A task due today whose time has passed stays under "Today", with the time in red. Groups with no tasks do not appear.

It is created as a bill to pay, never as paid: the system knows it is due, but not whether you have already paid it. Be careful: if you register a recurring bill for a day that has already passed this month, the system creates this month's bill within one day, even if you have already paid it.

Num computador cujo navegador não oferec: On a computer whose browser does not offer installation, the box says: "Open this address on your phone.
